modules.name: Riddim
modules.description: Dancehall riddim drum machine: 24 classic riddims (Sleng Teng, Rumours/Telephone Love, Dem Bow, Diwali, Dave Kelly and Lenky riddims), each with its machine flavour (Casio, 808, Linn, Simmons, sampler), ten synthesised voices, A/B variations, fills, swing, mutate, crush
